high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from the Moneycontrol website. The content of the article discusses a royal family member returning to her children and husband after being treated for a benign prostate problem. The King had been in hospital for this condition, which is non-cancerous and common among older men, according to the NHS. The article mentions that about one in three men over a certain age will have symptoms of an enlarged prostate, which is a gland located just below the bladder.
